overview: A family history app for the Norwood family with two complementary exploration views: a focused relationship navigator and a high-level family map, plus profiles, photos, and an archive.
features: Explore Family: a mobile-first focused relationship navigator centered on one person
Heritage Branch View: a simplified 10,000-foot map of major family lines and branches
Person profiles with photos, facts, stories, and timelines
Family archive with contributions and admin approval
